description: Corrected signal-peptide cleavage call for Adg2 and orthologs (h-region-constrained -3,-1 rule), and the omega-minus basic-residue (plasma-membrane retention) comparison across the fungal GPI panel
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
CHARGED=set("DEKR"); SMALL=set("GASTCNDV")
OM={'G':2.,'A':2.,'S':2.,'N':2.,'D':2.,'C':1.5,'T':.5,'V':0.}

def chd(seq,maxlook=45,min_kd=1.0):
    n=len(seq); best=None
    for L in range(5,min(maxlook,n)+1):
        suf=seq[n-L:]
        if any(c in CHARGED for c in suf): continue
        m=np.mean([KD[c] for c in suf if c in KD])
        if m>=min_kd: best=(n-L,L,m)
    return best

def gpi(seq):
    n=len(seq); h=chd(seq)
    if h is None: return None
    p,L,kd=h; cands=[]
    for w in range(max(0,p-15),p-6):
        a=seq[w]
        if a not in OM or w+2>=n: continue
        s=OM[a]+(0.5 if seq[w+1] not in "PW" else -1.)+(1.5 if seq[w+2] in SMALL else -1.)\
          +(1.5 if L>=10 else (1. if L>=8 else -1.))+(1.5 if kd>=2. else 1.)\
          +(0.5 if sum(c in CHARGED for c in seq[w+3:p])<=1 else -0.5)
        cands.append((round(s,2),w+1,a,seq[w+1],seq[w+2],p-w))
    if not cands: return None
    cands.sort(key=lambda x:(-x[0],x[1]))
    return dict(score=cands[0][0],omega=cands[0][1],tail_len=L,tail_kd=round(kd,2),ranked=cands[:5])

def sp_fixed(seq):
    """h-region-constrained (-3,-1) rule: cleavage searched only in the 8 residues after the h-region."""
    nreg=seq[:6]; nch=sum(c in "KR" for c in nreg)-sum(c in "DE" for c in nreg)
    best=(-9,None,None)
    for L in range(7,16):
        for st in range(3,20):
            if st+L>35: break
            m=np.mean([KD[c] for c in seq[st:st+L]])
            if m>best[0]: best=(m,st,L)
    hkd,hst,hl=best; cands=[]
    for c in range(hst+hl, min(hst+hl+9,len(seq))):
        sc=(2 if seq[c-1] in "AGSC" else -2)+(1.5 if seq[c-3] in "AGSCTVIL" else -1.5)+(1 if seq[c]!="P" else -1)
        cands.append((sc,c,seq[max(0,c-5):c+3]))
    cands.sort(key=lambda x:(-x[0],x[1]))
    return dict(n_charge=nch,h_maxKD=round(hkd,2),h_range=f"{hst+1}-{hst+hl}",
                cleave_after=cands[0][1],ctx=cands[0][2],alts=cands[:3])

uf=lambda a:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

print("="*70,"\nA. SIGNAL PEPTIDE, h-region-constrained cleavage call\n","="*70)
SPSET=[("O13854","Sp Adg2","UniProt SIGNAL 1-19, chain starts 20"),
       ("S9W079","S.cryo ortholog",""),("S9R663","S.octo ortholog",""),
       ("O13960","Sp Ecm33","UniProt SIGNAL 1-21"),
       ("P22146","Sc Gas1","UniProt SIGNAL 1-20"),
       ("Q9UR09","Sp Psu1","UniProt SIGNAL 1-20"),
       ("P60010","Sc Act1","cytosolic negative control")]
seqs={}
for acc,lab,note in SPSET:
    s=uf(acc); seqs[acc]=s; r=sp_fixed(s)
    print(f"{lab:18s} {acc}  len={len(s):4d}  h={r['h_range']} maxKD={r['h_maxKD']:5.2f}  "
          f"cleave_after={r['cleave_after']}  ctx={r['ctx']}   {note}")
print("\nAdg2 N-terminal 40 residues:", seqs['O13854'][:40])

print("\n","="*70,"\nB. OMEGA-MINUS BASIC RESIDUES (dibasic PM-retention rule)\n","="*70)
# S. cerevisiae proteins with experimentally established PM vs cell-wall GPI fate
FATE=[("P22146","Sc Gas1","plasma_membrane"),("P32329","Sc Yps1","plasma_membrane"),
      ("Q05031","Sc Dfg5","plasma_membrane"),("P53301","Sc Crh1","cell_wall"),
      ("P43497","Sc Cwp2","cell_wall"),("P28319","Sc Cwp1","cell_wall"),
      ("Q01589","Sc Sed1","cell_wall"),("P32768","Sc Sag1","cell_wall"),
      ("P27654","Sc Tip1","cell_wall")]
rows=[]
for acc,lab,fate in FATE+[("O13854","Sp Adg2","unknown"),("S9W079","S.cryo ortholog","unknown"),
                          ("S9R663","S.octo ortholog","unknown"),("O13960","Sp Ecm33","unknown"),
                          ("Q9UR09","Sp Psu1","unknown"),("Q9P378","Sp Gas1","unknown")]:
    s=seqs.get(acc) or uf(acc); seqs[acc]=s
    g=gpi(s)
    if not g: continue
    w=g["omega"]-1
    win=s[max(0,w-4):w+3]
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc,protein=lab,fate=fate,omega=g["omega"],omega_res=s[w],
                     window_wm4_wp2=win,n_KR=sum(c in "KR" for c in win),
                     dibasic=int("KK" in win or "KR" in win or "RK" in win or "RR" in win)))
F=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(F.to_string(index=False))
known=F[F.fate!="unknown"]
pm=known[known.fate=="plasma_membrane"].n_KR.values; cw=known[known.fate=="cell_wall"].n_KR.values
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
print(f"\nPM n_KR {list(pm)} mean {pm.mean():.2f}; CW n_KR {list(cw)} mean {cw.mean():.2f}")
try:
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(pm,cw,alternative='greater'); print(f"Mann-Whitney U={u} one-sided p={p:.3f}  (n={len(pm)} vs {len(cw)})")
except Exception as e: print(e)

print("\n","="*70,"\nC. ADG2 RANKED OMEGA CANDIDATES\n","="*70)
for c in gpi(seqs['O13854'])["ranked"]: print("  score=%.2f pos=%d omega=%s +1=%s +2=%s dist_to_tail=%d"%c)
print("Adg2 C-terminal 40:", seqs['O13854'][-40:])

# ---------------- figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
# panel 1: Adg2 C-terminal architecture
s=seqs['O13854']; n=len(s); win=9
h=[np.mean([KD[c] for c in s[max(0,i-win//2):i+win//2+1] if c in KD]) for i in range(n-60,n)]
x=list(range(n-60+1,n+1))
ax[0].plot(x,h,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.8)
ax[0].axhline(0,color="grey",lw=.7)
ax[0].axvspan(n-13,n,color="#f6ad55",alpha=.45,label="uncharged hydrophobic tail (14 aa, mean KD 2.91)")
ax[0].axvline(647,color="#c53030",ls="--",lw=1.6,label="predicted omega, Ser647")
ax[0].axvspan(650,n-14,color="#9ae6b4",alpha=.45,label="polar spacer")
ax[0].set_xlabel("Adg2 residue position"); ax[0].set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (window 9)")
ax[0].set_title("Adg2 C terminus has GPI signal architecture"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="upper left")
# panel 2: omega-minus basic residues
order=["plasma_membrane","cell_wall","unknown"]; cols={"plasma_membrane":"#2b6cb0","cell_wall":"#dd6b20","unknown":"#718096"}
for i,f in enumerate(order):
    sub=F[F.fate==f]
    ax[1].scatter(np.full(len(sub),i)+np.linspace(-.18,.18,len(sub)),sub.n_KR,
                  s=70,color=cols[f],edgecolor="k",linewidth=.5,zorder=3)
    for xj,(_,r) in zip(np.linspace(-.18,.18,len(sub)),sub.iterrows()):
        ax[1].annotate(r.protein.replace("Sc ","").replace("Sp ",""),(i+xj,r.n_KR),
                       fontsize=6.5,ha="center",va="bottom",rotation=0)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(3)); ax[1].set_xticklabels(["PM-retained\n(Sc)","cell wall\n(Sc)","Adg2 and\nrelatives"])
ax[1].set_ylabel("basic residues (K/R) in omega-4 to omega+2")
ax[1].set_title("Omega-minus basic rule does not separate\nAdg2 from either fate")
ax[1].set_ylim(-0.4,3); ax[1].grid(axis="y",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
